# Exact coupled-face Green and a pooled catalyst coordinate

30 October 2026. New working construction, NOT independently reviewed. It preserves the previously reviewed compiler and the exact non-small-return obstruction. The purpose is to remove that bottleneck with an actual stopped operator, not assert its old norm small.

## Primary comparator and choice of representation

Laurence–Robert, [Scaling Methods for Stochastic Chemical Reaction Networks, §2.4](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.01949v3#S2.SS4), states a Filonov criterion: a normlike energy with an integrable state-dependent stopping time, bounded below by the first jump truncated at a fixed constant, and expected energy loss dominating expected elapsed time yields positive recurrence. This supplies a stopping-time method, not automatic coverage of this network. It motivates grouping a complete coupled-face excursion before estimating drift. Publisher access returned403; the author preprint was accessible. No denied Wisconsin source was accessed.

## 1. Exact deficiency-two module

Residual species a,C,E,D, with physical A=a+a0, a0>=2, m=a0+2. Fixed positive rates for

    a+D -> C+D       nu a D,
    C+D -> E+D       lambda C D,
    E+D -> a+D       mu E D,
    a+D -> 2a        kappa a D,
    2D -> a+D        rho (D)_2,
    2a -> a+D        k1 (a)_2,
    2a -> 2D         k2 (a)_2,
    C+D -> C+E       beta C D,
    C+E -> C+D       gamma C E,

plus clearing k0(a)_2. All fast rates are multiplied by (A)_a0(B)_q, with q>m and the same connector. Total n=a+C+E+D is conserved before clearing. The local module is considered on n>=2 and nonnegative residual a (so A>=a0); any smaller inactive exceptions belong to the finite connector head, not this local stage. Both seed channels are positive for the proposed global weakly reversible model.

The old D=0 interface is indeed non-small: from a=E=0,C=n-1,D=1, the first fast jump enters D=0 with probability beta/(beta+lambda). Nothing below removes or misprices that event.

Instead define the TRUE dormant set

    F={D=0, C E=0},

with two components (C-axis and E-axis, their overlap included once). The mixed face M0={D=0,C E>0} is active and is included inside the active module M={D>0} union M0. Stop an M-stage at the first true-F entrance, clearing, or connector event. A seed inside M is not a stop for the full stage, though it is a restart for local estimates

30 October 2026. WORKING whole construction, NOT independently reviewed. Depends on COUPLED_FACE_TRACE_GREEN_AND_POOL and the previously reviewed finite-grade phase/transfer bundles. It does not infer a full theorem from the old non-small D=0 return estimate.

## Exact proposed conclusion and model

For the exact five-species deficiency-two module in COUPLED_FACE_TRACE_GREEN_AND_POOL, attached to the same connector with a0>=2, m=a0+2, q>m and all stated core/pair rates positive, the proposed conclusion is nonexplosion, positive recurrence of each communicating class, and every prescribed total-count exponential invariant moment. This is a restricted coupled architecture, not a general deficiency-two or weakly reversible theorem.

The new local work changes the interface itself:

    active module M={D>0} union {D=0,CE>0},
    true dormant F={D=0,CE=0}.

The order-one crossings D>0 -> D=0,CE>0 are INTERNAL to M and are paid by the exact mixed-face holding Green. Only returns to F enter the small interface kernel.

## 1. The two true dormant components retain their actual labels

Partition F into

    F_C={D=0,E=0},
    F_E={D=0,C=0,E>0}.

The overlap is assigned to F_C. Before a seed, all hidden C,E counts on either face are frozen. The only fast events are the same 2a seeds and clearing; connector events have exactly the same A,B rates. Thus, conditional on the hidden count and the face label, the A,B stopped law is EXACTLY the previously earned dormant connector law. This is an identity of kernels, not an asymptotic comparison.

The pure dormant section Green is therefore block diagonal diag(G_C,G_E), with each block the existing phase-weighted/graded Green. Its sup norm is their maximum, not a factor for a randomly resampled face. It retains exp(theta r+lambda B), every requested finite inverse profile and real residual power. A seed has its actual A decrement, actual B and residual, and enters M. A section return before a seed is terminal.

The face label can change only through an actual M excursion. The local bound controls the SUM of the outgoing rewards to F_C and F_E:

    R f_s <= C n^(-1/10) f_s

by n^-1/5 true-face rarity and acquired f_(2s) transport. Hence after composing the actual seed kernel with the block-diagonal dormant Green, the TOTAL seed-mediated F->F operator has small weighted norm.

# Coupled pooled-label and active-domain conventions

30 October 2026. Completion to the two new coupled-face files; prior reviewed sources unchanged.

## Pooled labels are abstract

Labels in the forcing proof describe (a,C,z), not persistent physical E or D identities. With z=E+D-1, set R=mu E+rho(D-1)>=c z. Give each z label an independent baseline clock of rate c. At a baseline event choose the physical E-consuming or D-consuming channel with probabilities mu E/R and rho(D-1)/R. The aggregate baseline contribution to each physical channel is <= its actual rate. Realize each nonnegative remainder as an adapted extra event, assigning any z label. The a+D birth is another extra z->a event when z>=1 and is the actual true-F stop when z=0.

A single protected pool particle can be reassigned before the physical update; no observable state changes during relabeling. This constructs the exact (a,C,E,D) generator while retaining independent per-label BASELINE Poisson clocks. It does not construct independent E/D particle chains. Extra pooled z->a moves cannot invalidate the forcing event when no a-departure clock rings.

The a and C pooled labels retain their identities through their baseline moves. After a seed removes a cohort label, its fictitious continuation can use its same baseline clocks with no extra moves. The difference between the actual surviving cohort and this fictitious reference cohort is bounded by twice the seed count.
